responses.text: {Bewildered}What the hell?{slight pause}Is that a half-robot dog?
{Gratitude}You better control that{slight pause, sizing E-DE}thing. Bots can't be trusted.
{Gratitude}A Follower is always welcome among our people.
{Restrained Warning}Keep the Ranger on a leash around here.
{Inquisitive}Another Supermutant roaming outer New Vegas, huh?
{Proud Assertion}All humans are welcome here, even Ghouls.
{Relieved}That Fiend leader got what he fucking deserved.
{Disappointed}Fuck that Fiend bastard. Wish I would've seen him die.
{Pessimistic Resignation}Can't help thinking that we've not seen the last of the Fiends yet.
{Relieved}I hope the Fiends have learned their lesson.
{Relieved}Won't have to worry about those Fiend assholes for some time now, huh?
{Happily Surprised}We should reclaim the rest of city, if the rumors about House are true.
{Pessimistic Sarcasm}You saved the NCR's head honcho, sure you can save a bunch of low-life scum like us.
{Pessimistic Sarcasm}Got time to save us too, or are you running errands for your NCR masters?
{Satisfied}Even Presidents die, huh? Good.
{Defiant, then relieved}That Legion boss would've never taken the city, but I'm glad he's a goner.
If there's war in the end, it won't affect our city.
Looks like the entire region's going straight where we are - knee-deep in shit.
{Excited}Going to place me a good bet at The Thorn.
{Excited}Saw a monster rip a man in half at The Thorn.
{Amazement}Hey, you're the one that's been hunting the most dangerous beasts for The Thorn!
{Honest Praise}Hey, It's great what you're doing for The Thorn, way to go!
{Amazement}Wish I could've seen you capture those beasts for our Thorn!
{Bewildered}Killing Fire Geckos at The Thorn is no joke, you're quite the fighter!
{Bewildered}You've taken down Cazadores! Didn't think I'd ever see that.
{Bewildered}I heard you've killed Deathclaws at The Thorn. I couldn't believe it!
{Excited}One of these days, Red Lucy's going to show off her Deathclaws.
{Dumbfounded}All hell broke loose when the creatures escaped from The Thorn!
{Dumbfounded}One of those beasts cut my friend in half! How the hell did they escape from Red Lucy?
{Dumbfounded}Can't believe that The Thorn's no more.
{Slight Sarcasm}Fiends don't come here no more, they say.
{Slight Sarcasm}New Vegas, paradise, my ass.
{Slight Sarcasm}NCR should head back to their lands, I'm sure *their* people miss them.
{Matter of Course Warning}Keep an eye on your stuff - damn thieves.
{Matter of Course Warning}Careful with those Fiends in the western sewers.
{Anxious Apprehension}I need my fix.
{Anxious Apprehension}I hurt all over.
{Anxious Apprehension}Going to eat the next fucking rat I see.
{Anxious Apprehension}Just got to find me some sweet Jet.
{Beaten Resignation}Can't go anywhere else.
{Thankful}Good to see you respect the Followers.
{Cautionary}Make sure the NCR dog behaves, you're in the Mojave now.
{Approving}Your merchant friend is always welcome among us.
{Apprehensive Curiosity}That bot of yours don't look like anything I've seen in the Mojave.
{Overt Curiosity}Your friend's not from the desert, is she?
{Suspicious}We tolerate Wasteland savages, as long as they respect our rule around here.
{Lamenting}It's too bad the NCR boss got out alive.
The wind's changing. I can see trouble ahead.
{Slight Concern}The Hostetlers have gone through quite some trouble, lately.
{Lamenting}Terrible thing, what happened to the Hostetlers.
